# Aurane

**Stellar Data:** A single class G8-V star, mass 0.87 solar, luminosity 0.57, aged 7 gigayears. The home system of the Senaveil Accord. Its two settled worlds are Tellane, the homeworld, and Alba, settled by rocket before Trans-Newtonian technology. The scar of the near-miss on Witness is the reason for the Compact.

- **Planetary Bodies:** 6 terrestrial planets, 2 gas giants

- **Wellheads:** Regane, Sovrane
- **Colonies:** Tellane (911.57 million), Alba (102.8 million), Witness (0.52 million)
